column1: # Maven dependency → licence notice, for the app's runtime classpath.
# Consumed by :app:generateLicenseIndex / :app:verifyLicenseIndex. Every module on
# the resolved runtime classpath must match a row here or the build fails — that is
# the guard that keeps a new dependency from shipping without a notice. See
# docs/licenses.md.
# One row per module, TAB-separated. '#' starts a comment; blank lines ignored.
#   1  group:artifact        exact match on the resolved module (version-independent,
#                            so a version bump needs no edit), or a prefix rule ending
#                            in '*' — e.g. `androidx.*` covers every `androidx.<x>:<y>`
#   2  licence label         shown in the in-app viewer
#   3  licence text file(s)  comma-separated, relative to app/src/main/assets/
#   4  notice file           asset path, or '-'
#   5  provenance            where the licence was verified from
# Every row below was checked on 2026-09-13 against the <licenses> block of that
# module's own published POM — not against a group's reputation. 76 of the 78
# resolved modules declare Apache-2.0 in exactly those words (four spellings of it
# occur), jna declares a dual licence, and com.google.guava:listenablefuture
# declares nothing at all in its own POM, which is why its row cites its parent.
androidx.*
column5: POM <licenses> of each resolved androidx module on Google Maven (dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/.../*.pom) — "The Apache Software License, Version 2.0", checked 2026-09-13
